evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction creation and fee bumping in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
rationale: Prevents unnatural locktime backdating during RBF that fingerprints Bitcoin Core transactions. While the wallet rubric prioritizes privacy of transaction creation and fingerprinting, this bug affects only a small percentage of RBF replacements (under 2% according to the author's empirical survey), making the fix worthwhile but deferrable.
